headline: President Trump signed an executive order titled "Establishing the United States Space Academy."
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up or directs the creation of a United States Space Academy. No summary was provided, so details are not known. These include who would run it, who could attend, what it would teach, and how it would be paid for.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies such as the Department of Defense or the Space Force may be asked to help create or run the academy, but the order's exact assignments are not stated in the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Students interested in space or military careers
who_it_affects.how: They could become eligible to apply to a new academy, though admission rules and other details are not known.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 28, 2026. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, but the timeline for actually setting up the academy is not stated.
